answer_1.quote: We propose a framework called REFILL ( § 2) for generating diverse text queries for a given SQL workload that is often readily available.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language text queries for SQL

answer_2.quote: We measure quality using the BLEU score of the set S(q) of generated text for an SQL q, with the gold text of q as reference. To measure diversity we utilize SelfBLEU.
